scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0085; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “I have the money.” and “I need money.” are plausible short A1 utterances in the stated scene.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently preserves the bounded lesson meaning of money.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors separate the intended answer from the transfer response and unrelated familiar language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The lesson stays at short early-A1 utterance length and introduces one bounded lexical target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the communicative context while preserving the target sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities and outcome align on the same bounded target.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
